title: Fix the weather check
prompt:
This program has four problems: a missing colon, a line that isn't indented, a variable name that is a keyword, and a debugging `print` that should not run.

Fix the program so that it prints only:

```
Take an umbrella
```

Turn the debugging line off with a comment instead of deleting it.
starter:
raining = True
class = "umbrella"
print("Debug: checking the weather")
if raining
print("Take an", class)
else:
    print("Leave it at home")
solution:
raining = True
item = "umbrella"
# print("Debug: checking the weather")
if raining:
    print("Take an", item)
else:
    print("Leave it at home")
hints: `class` is a keyword, so it can't be a variable name. Pick another name and change it in both places.
An `if` line ends with a colon, and the lines inside the block are indented by 4 spaces.
Put `#` at the start of the debugging line to turn it into a comment.
